A.rows: sellers 24; seller changes 35; orders 96; order items 192; completed orders 72; payouts 73; tags 28; targets 12
insights: seller_tags is legitimate membership data, but joining it before GMV aggregation multiplies transaction value.
The S008 same-day conflicting history rows create ambiguous as-of truth and must block historical attribution until resolved.
The orphan payout must remain visible in the quality exception path; matched payout total is 163680.00 and orphan amount is 500.00.
Category targets are month-category grain. Beauty has targets even though completed Beauty GMV is zero, so missing/zero actual must not be silently dropped.

B.rows: warehouses 8; products 30; supplier changes 36; inventory snapshots 720; purchase orders 48; receipts 37; reorder rules 120
insights: Inventory on hand is a snapshot measure: summing 10 days to 41275 is not a valid current-stock total; the latest-day total is 4105.
P012 has two suppliers on the same effective date, so as-of supplier history is ambiguous until repaired.
The orphan receipt must not be deleted to make referential checks pass.
Reorder rules are product-warehouse grain; do not assume every possible product/warehouse pair has a rule.

C.rows: accounts 25; account changes 31; subscriptions 60; renewals 60; interactions 120; usage rows 121; targets 9
insights: Renewals, interactions and daily usage are separate grains. Joining them raw by account repeats renewal value many times.
Closed-opportunity renewal rate is 20/(20+20)=50%; wins divided by all 60 opportunities is 33.3%. The metric definition must name whether open opportunities are excluded.
A010 has conflicting same-day region history; current account master cannot resolve historical truth automatically.
Monthly segment targets are month-segment grain; reconcile at that grain rather than copying targets onto subscriptions or interactions.
